description:
Programme Overview

The Hellenic Robotics Center of Excellence HERON and the National Technical University of Athens (NTUA) are offering fully funded PhD positions in robotics and artificial intelligence research. HERON is Greece's first Robotics Center of Excellence, funded under the European Union's Horizon Europe Widening Program (Teaming for Excellence).

Research Areas

Applications are invited in the following topics:

  • Reinforcement Learning for Computer Vision
  • Theoretical Methods and Algorithms for Deep Learning with Geometric Reasoning
  • Embodied Artificial Intelligence for Robot Perception and Multimodal Learning
  • Vision-Language Models: Theory and Applications to Cognitive and Robotic Systems
  • Autonomous Navigation for Field Robotic Vehicles
  • Robot Learning and Intelligent Control in Dexterous, Agile and Collaborative Robotics
  • Telerobotic Surgery and Haptics
  • Cognitive Robotic Systems for Human Assistance and Rehabilitation
  • Multi-sensor Perception and Learning with Applications to Automated Environments
  • Surgical Telerobotics and Haptics
  • Robot-Assisted Surgery: Methods and Technologies for Non-Intrusive Navigation and Guidance
  • Methodologies and Algorithms for the Control of Assist-as-Needed Robotic Rehabilitation Systems
  • Methodologies and Algorithms for Increasing the Level of Autonomy in Robotically Assisted Surgery

Supervisory Team

  • Prof. Petros Maragos (Director of HERON) – maragos@cs.ntua.gr
  • Prof. Costas Tzafestas – ktzaf@cs.ntua.gr
  • Assist. Prof. Panagiotis Vartholomeos – pvarthol@mail.ntua.gr

What We're Looking For

  • Strong academic background in Electrical and Computer Engineering or related fields.
  • Passion for interdisciplinary research at the intersection of Robotics and AI.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and research aptitude.
  • Programming experience and genuine interest in robotics.
  • Strong work ethic and enthusiasm for collaborative, cross-disciplinary research.
  • Motivation to work in an international research environment.

What We Offer

  • Join an international, collaborative research community working alongside researchers in robotics and AI.
  • Strong industrial partnerships.
  • Opportunities for international research stays.
  • Access to state-of-the-art facilities and resources.
  • Mentorship from leading experts in the field.
  • Fully funded PhD scholarships and research assistantships provided by HERON.

International Collaboration

HERON brings together the Athena Research Center (coordinating partner), leading Greek university professors, and two international partners: the Italian Institute of Technology (IIT) and the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT).

How to Apply

  • Official Application: Visit the formal announcement at the NTUA School of Electrical and Computer Engineering: https://www.ece.ntua.gr/el/announcementDetails/1a7dce71-790a-11f1-a8ea-000c296d8b20 (announcement in Greek).
  • For Inquiries: Contact phd@heron-robotics-coe.eu for questions about the PhD positions and application process.

Official Links

  • HERON Website: https://heron-robotics-coe.eu
  • NTUA: https://www.ntua.gr/en
  • Current PhD Positions Page: https://heron-robotics-coe.eu/news/fully-funded-phd-positions-in-robotics-and-ai-starting-academic-year-2026-27/

Important Notes

  • Positions are fully funded through HERON scholarships and research assistantships.
  • Contact the team directly for current deadlines and start dates.
  • Announcements for NTUA are in Greek.
